svg.title: F73 list toolbar, mobile People (owner): toolbar, merged status line and A–Z rail, three skins
svg.desc: 375px viewport. The title, then one toolbar row: native sort select, icon-only List/Poster toggle and the owner ⋯ menu. The count line absorbs the sweep and duplicates banners. The A–Z index is a one-column rail on the right edge (text-xs, 16px pitch), so no letters sit above the first row. Real tokens for all three skins.
